<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Curvia_MedicineRequest">10547956c34d03d05619533ed401318d</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:d349b0b6c3cd07d05619533ed401317e</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Pickup Date Validation </name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading, isTemplate) {
   if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
      return;
   }

    var selectedDate = getDateFromFormat(newValue, g_user_date_time_format);
    var now = new Date();

    // Minimum allowed time = now + 1 hour
    var minTime = new Date(now.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000));

    if (selectedDate < minTime) {
        g_form.showFieldMsg(
            'preferred_pickup_date',
            'Preferred pickup date and time must be at least 1 hour from now.',
            'error'
        );
    }
			else{
			g_form.hideFieldMsg('preferred_pickup_date', true);

		}
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-05 06:13:40</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>23acd311c3dd4f145619533ed4013183</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Pickup Date Validation </sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Pharmacy Management System" source="x_1970979_pharma_0">7f81de0ac30d8f905619533ed4013110</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Pharmacy Management System">7f81de0ac30d8f905619533ed4013110</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_23acd311c3dd4f145619533ed4013183</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-05 06:23:58</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || !newValue) return;

    // Get quantity - works in Service Portal
    var requestedQty = 1;
    
    try {
        // Method 1: g_form.getControl (most reliable in SP)
        var qtyControl = g_form.getControl('quantity');
        if (qtyControl) {
            requestedQty = parseInt(qtyControl.value) || 1;
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    try {
        // Method 2: Angular scope fallback
        if (requestedQty === 1) {
            var qtyEl = document.querySelector('.quantity-input input') ||
                        document.querySelector('[name="sysparm_quantity"]') ||
                        document.querySelector('input.ng-valid[min="1"]');
            if (qtyEl) requestedQty = parseInt(qtyEl.value) || 1;
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    checkMedicineAvailability(newValue, requestedQty);
}

function checkMedicineAvailability(medicineName, requestedQty) {
    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1970979_pharma_0.MedicineAvailability');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'checkAvailability');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_medicine_name', medicineName);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_requested_qty', requestedQty);
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {
        var result = JSON.parse(answer);

        if (result.status === 'available') {
            g_form.showFieldMsg('medicine_name',
                'Available, ' + result.quantity + ' units in stock', 'info');

        } else if (result.status === 'low') {
            if (requestedQty > result.quantity) {
                g_form.showFieldMsg('medicine_name',
                    'Insufficient Stock, you requested ' + requestedQty +
                    ' but only ' + result.quantity + ' units left', 'error');
            } else {
                g_form.showFieldMsg('medicine_name',
                    'Low Stock, only ' + result.quantity + ' units left'+ requestedQty +
                    ' but only ' , 'warning');
					g_cart.setQuantity(10);
            }

        } else if (result.status === 'expired') {
            g_form.showFieldMsg('medicine_name',
                'Expired, cannot be requested', 'error');

        } else {
            g_form.showFieldMsg('medicine_name',
                'Not Found, please check the medicine name', 'error');
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-26 21:32:45</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b9131f52c3c943d05619533ed4013193</sys_id><sys_mod_count>27</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Medicine Availability</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Pharmacy Management System" source="x_1970979_pharma_0">7f81de0ac30d8f905619533ed4013110</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Pharmacy Management System">7f81de0ac30d8f905619533ed4013110</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_b9131f52c3c943d05619533ed4013193</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-05 08:10:06</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
